artifacts.summary: FrameOver restructured to PosRel on D+ plus the four def:frame axioms; reflection law derived as FrameOver.reflection; all sites migrated; converse->reflection convention renamed across Lean/docs/typst/latex; full build, tests, module invariants and readme-lint green.

completion_data.completion_summary: FrameOver's fields are now exactly WorldState, worldNonempty, a primitive PosRel on the positive cone, and the four def:frame axioms; the two-sided TaskRel is the definition TaskFrame.reflect PosRel and the reflection law is the derived theorem FrameOver.reflection (smart constructor FrameOver.ofReflective for two-sided presentations). All construction sites and concrete-frame consumers were migrated, and 'converse convention' was renamed to 'reflection convention' across Lean, docs, typst and LaTeX with def:task-relation/def:deterministic re-pinned.
